Definition: to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to quiver, totter, shake, reel, stagger, wander, move, sift, make move, wave, waver, tremble; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to wave, quiver, vibrate, swing, stagger, tremble, be unstable; 1a2) to totter, go tottering; 1a2a) vagabond (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be tossed about or around; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to toss about; 1c2) to shake, cause to totter; 1c3) to shake, disturb; 1c4) to cause to wander
